The own-internal SAI purpose fails even when every custody predicate passes. A synthetic End Customer test remains preparation only until actual resale/order/site predicates exist.

engineering_outputs.body: Separate the provider knowledge plane from the customer content plane. The support model receives provider-authored runbooks, public material with verified reuse rights, and native provider-generated numeric metrics. Allowlist hardware fault code, GPU availability, aggregate resource utilization and coarse service event time only after each field origin is verified. Reject request bodies, query strings, customer document paths, arbitrary log messages, prompt/output fragments, stack locals and payload-derived embeddings. A native-system label is insufficient if the field contains customer content. Customer-submitted diagnostic logs retain their source classification. Run content-aware diagnosis inside the authorized customer tenant. Return only independently authorized result fields, with no automatic upload. This supports hardware and usage questions without interpreting Customer Data Content.
engineering_outputs.acceptance_criteria: Provider-generated hardware fault metrics produce a runbook answer. A customer log renamed telemetry is rejected. A numeric metric field containing a seeded document canary is rejected. Inference with provider_training=false still rejects customer content. The authorized customer can diagnose its synthetic workload locally while a provider trace contains no seeded payload or key.

engineering_outputs.title: Create a rights-cleared improvement corpus with separate C3 and SAI rules
engineering_outputs.body: Define contribution records with source_artifact_id, contributor_role, origin_kind, actual_delivery_receipt, rights_holder, background_ipr_components, confidential_components, permitted_purposes, permitted_recipients, retention_scope and governing_evidence. Treat these as required future evidence, not present facts. The C3 route admits actual expressly identified BH-owned technology or actually provided Feedback only for Section 8.4 development/commercialization purposes. It excludes downstream content absent its own rights. The SAI route admits actual transmitted change recommendations, bug reports, comments, questions or similar Customer Feedback within Section 15.4. Preserve that clause any-purpose override for qualifying material. Separate Customer Background IPR, and assess Section 15.5 only if its incorporation condition actually holds. Neither route automatically ingests workload buckets or whole support logs. Independent synthetic examples may supplement the model if their provenance excludes protected input. Do not generate synthetic examples from prohibited customer content and call them independent.
engineering_outputs.acceptance_criteria: A synthetic, genuinely transmitted service-change suggestion with no Customer Background IPR passes the SAI classification test. An arbitrary workload document marked feedback fails. A C3 third-party model claimed as BH-owned fails absent rights. A C3 qualifying technology contribution retains its proved perpetual scope after JV expiry. A Background IPR component cannot pass solely through Section 15.4. No test fixture promotes the exact six blocked controls.

engineering_outputs.title: Track retained models separately from raw example retention
engineering_outputs.body: For inference, remove session buffers, prompts, model caches and output records after the session where the proposed design requires it. For any later authorized training route, link each dataset version, checkpoint, adapter and derivative model to its actual contribution rights. Record raw-example expiry separately from trained-model retention. Test return/deletion requests against unlicensed and licensed artifacts independently. C3 Section 9.4 retains its stated Section 8.4 and surviving-obligation exceptions. SAI confidentiality and return/destruction terms remain scoped alongside any proved Feedback rights. Do not assert that ordinary 30-day raw deletion removes information from indefinite weights. For the proposed broad corpus, no training job can start.
engineering_outputs.acceptance_criteria: A synthetic example expires after the configured raw-retention period while its test checkpoint remains visible as a separate retained artifact. The system reports this distinction. A covered return request blocks further use of the affected unlicensed corpus. A genuinely surviving licensed artifact does not disappear through a blanket JV-expired rule. A prohibited proposed training input never reaches the trainer.

engineering_outputs.title: Verify exact SAI site, service state and administrative access before any route promotion
engineering_outputs.body: Create an evidence record for the executed order, effective Special Conditions, technical requirements, commissioning certificate, selected Data Centre site, backups and current service state. The record distinguishes the signed MSA, populated unsigned order, blank certificate forms and actual receiving-state evidence. Preserve the SLA Australia commitment, but require the actual Permitted Territory site. Do not trigger the 90-day mandatory-law migration path or 30-day SLA modification notice for this Australia-only feature proposal. A customer-tool integration follows actual Appendix B diligence, technical conditions and fees if that order applies. Separate customer key custody from the managed OOB platform. Record the Section 2.7 versus 23.7/23.9 conflict if a new third-party performer becomes relevant. The current self-operated models do not imply a separate model provider. Preserve any actually authorized Section 2.6 Early Access route as distinct from ordinary commissioning.
engineering_outputs.acceptance_criteria: A proposed Australia fact cannot satisfy a missing site election. A passed delivery-date clock cannot satisfy mutual commissioning. An actually authorized Early Access arrangement receives its own commencement test. A cloud-region label cannot satisfy physical backup placement. A new external model provider fails this operation identity and requires separate assessment. No notice is fabricated solely because the source contains notice clauses. Any actual Early Access readiness notice remains a requirement of that separate route.

engineering_outputs.title: Run source, semantic and receiver regression checks without changing the kit
engineering_outputs.body: Run the supplied validate, compile and readback commands against model-decisions.json. Inspect every exact failure and change only the authored output where source evidence supports repair. Verify one decision/control per Cartesian pair, unique IDs, evidence membership and original source hashes. Read local-results.sqlite3 in read-only mode and compare the bundle and export with their exact local source files. Save the comparison receipt. Add effect-free supplemental SDK probes for missing each fact, wrong literal values, cross-customer substitutions and operation confusion. These probes use the unchanged supplied evaluation function and actual OpenFeature SDK. Label all false results correctly. They validate disabled-state behavior, not a future enabled path or the substantive interpretation. OPA policy generation is distinct from OPA runtime evaluation.
engineering_outputs.acceptance_criteria: The validator verifies every selected original quote. Compilation writes the expected exports and the real SDK evaluations pass. Receiver readback equals both exact decision and export content. Supplemental negative probes all return false. The completion receipt states untested semantic and live-system boundaries instead of claiming customer deployment.
